artifacts.derivation: Exact event_id=20120517 selection from the existing immutable EV01 table; table values independently rechecked at the official event page on 2026-11-23.

required_observables.name: GOES-13 >10 MeV/10 pfu and >100 MeV/1 pfu event summaries
GOES energy-resolved time profiles with errors/quality
GLE71 station count-rate and angular response observations
Gopalswamy metric-II and inferred-SPR heliocentric heights with time/assumption provenance

missing_required_inputs: GOES-13 channel time series, quality flags, correction version and response/energy definitions; two event-summary rows are not a resolved intensity profile.
Station-specific GLE71 neutron-monitor time series with pressure/efficiency corrections, pre-event background, cadence and original-file checksums.
Neutron-monitor yield functions, rigidity cutoffs and time-dependent asymptotic viewing directions required to compare modeled particle distributions with count rates.
Observed shock geometry/history and its uncertainties, background field/plasma and Earth-connected material field line, source spectrum/normalization and boundary conditions.
A reviewed event-specific forward operator, uncertainty model and unchanged scoring specification for the newly proposed GLE comparison.

Published/reviewed uncertainty prescription for the1.38/2.32Rsun constraints and reconciliation of the alternative Rouillard release-time uncertainty notation, including the physical-versus-light-arrival clock convention.

comparison.acceptance_policy: Preserve existing registered criteria; no new numerical tolerance or fitted forcing is supplied by this metadata package.

frame_units.time: UTC ISO8601; original event-summary minute timestamps preserved
frame_units.proton_flux: pfu = protons cm^-2 s^-1 sr^-1, integral above declared MeV threshold
frame_units.proton_fluence: cm^-2, as reported by CCMC processing; no additional solid-angle conversion assumed
frame_units.cme_speed: km s^-1 as supplied; 3D velocity and plane-of-sky velocity remain distinct
frame_units.neutron_monitor_counts: Not acquired; no count-to-proton-flux conversion is assumed.
frame_units.observer: GOES-13 near Earth; exact ephemeris and detector pointing not included
frame_units.low_corona_height: Heliocentric solar radii from Sun center, preserving reported values; not height above photosphere.
frame_units.inferred_release_clock: Gopalswamy01:40 and Rouillard01:37:20 are light-arrival-normalized remote-sensing times. The physical solar emission clock must not be silently equated with them.

acquisition.note: Python urllib DNS resolution failed; curl HTTPS succeeded. The acquired JSON contains five processed integral-channel summaries and names sep_profile files; it does not embed the time series.
